methodology.claim_extraction: Count only final confirmed_strict_miss records, plus the legacy gap-audit confirmed-miss fields. O3 discovery hits and positive controls are provenance only.
methodology.deduplication: Deduplicate by episode_id. The full 2,365-episode denominator was also checked for duplicate (alert_start, alert_end) intervals under different IDs.
methodology.canonical_state: Frozen canonical aggregate is kyiv-air-alerts-grafana/data/explosion_audited_baseline.json. Canonical evidence is kyiv-air-alerts-grafana/data/explosion_research/zaporizhzhia/final_evidence.json. The 169 strict episode IDs were reconstructed losslessly from all 169 strict_events against the nine frozen Zaporizhzhia denominator slices.
methodology.temporal_rule: Strict matching requires exact-city evidence, aerial-war context, and event-time evidence for the target alert. Explicit during-alert wording, stated event time inside the alert, or contemporaneous in-alert event messages qualify. Publication/update time by itself does not.
